# declutter

> A disk cleanup CLI for developers on macOS and Ubuntu, written in pure bash
> (3.2+, no dependencies). It scans the machine, shows a checkbox list with real
> sizes, pre-ticks only provably safe caches, and deletes nothing until the user
> confirms. Its distinguishing focus is the junk AI coding tools leave behind —
> Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI transcripts, AI chat webview storage in VS Code
> and Cursor, HuggingFace caches, Ollama model weights — which `apt clean` and
> `brew cleanup` do not touch.

Repository: https://github.com/phamquyetthang/declutter
License: MIT
Language: bash
Platforms: macOS (Intel & Apple Silicon), Ubuntu/Debian

## Install

```
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phamquyetthang/declutter/main/install.sh | bash
```

Installs to `~/.local/bin/declutter` (override with `PREFIX`). Uninstall with
`./install.sh --uninstall`.

## Core concepts

- Three safety tiers. **green** = caches that provably regenerate, pre-ticked.
  **yellow** = you lose history or a long rebuild, never pre-ticked.
  **red** = real data or a decision only the user can make (`node_modules`, Ollama
  models, Docker volumes, Xcode Archives, Maven repo); reported with its size but
  **not selectable**, and no flag can make the tool delete it. `--level red` is
  rejected on purpose.
- Nothing is deleted without confirmation: the user presses Enter, or passes `--yes`.
- `--dry-run` logs every exact path it would remove and touches no disk.
- Items whose paths do not exist are never listed.
- Every action is appended to `~/.declutter.log`.

## Commands

- `declutter` — scan, interactive checkbox list, Enter to clean
- `declutter --report` — print the list, exit, delete nothing
- `declutter --json` — the same list as one JSON object (for scripts and agents)
- `declutter --yes` — clean the green tier without the list
- `declutter --yes -l yellow` — include the yellow tier
- `declutter --dry-run --yes` — rehearse and log, delete nothing
- `declutter --projects [DIR]` — list heavy node_modules/target/.venv (never deletes)
- `declutter --only GROUPS` / `--skip GROUPS` — filter by group, comma-separated
- `declutter --days N` — "old" threshold for transcripts and --projects (default 60)
- `declutter --lang en|vi` — interface language (auto-detected from $LANG)
- `declutter --deep` — enable slow scans (walk $HOME for __pycache__)

## Groups

`ai-cli` `ai-ide` `ai-ml` `ai-model` `pkg-node` `pkg-python` `pkg-rust` `pkg-go`
`pkg-java` `docker` `browser` `os` `xcode`

## JSON contract (stable from 1.1.0)

Top level: `version`, `platform`, `lang`, `level`, `dry_run`, `free_kb`,
`free_human`, `items[]`, `totals{items,preselected,preselected_kb,preselected_human}`.
Each item: `level`, `group`, `action`, `desc`, `size_kb`, `size_human`, `paths[]`,
`selectable` (false for red), `preselected`.

## Never touched

`~/.ssh`, `~/.gnupg`, `~/.aws`, `.env` files, login tokens,
`~/.claude/settings.json` and `skills`/`agents`/`memory`, VS Code
`User/settings.json`/`keybindings.json`/`snippets`/`History`, browser profiles
(only cache directories are in scope), Docker volumes, Xcode Archives, the Maven
repo, Timeshift/Time Machine snapshots, `node_modules` and `target/`.
